title: Grateful Dead Live at Kresge Plaza - MIT on 1970-05-06
lineage: Panasonic SV-3700 > Cardas cable S/PDIF > Edirol UA-5 > analog out > Korg MR-1 DFF @ [1bit/2.8 mhz] Rate Conversion: AudioGate to [24bit/96 khz] Mastering: In WaveLab with Nomad Factory Plugins Rate Conversion with r8brain to [16bit/44.1 mhz] > TLH > Flac
source: Master Soundboard Reels 10", 2-sided, 1/2 Track Mono > DAT x 1

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a tight early‑May 1970 show with stellar Dancin' in the Streets jam and crisp guitar work, though a brief cut between St. Stephen and Not Fade Away slightly disrupts flow.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its energetic set – highlights include an expansive Dancin' in the Streets, electrifying Jerry Garcia solos on China > Rider, a punchy Good Lovin', and moving renditions of Morning Dew and St. Stephen. The soundboard source delivers clear instrument separation and strong vocals, with only a subtle edit between St. Stephen and Not Fade Away that mildly affects continuity.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers give 5‑star ratings and emphasize strong playing, especially Garcia’s guitar and the set's tightness; recording is a soundboard with good clarity but a minor edit, yielding an overall high but not flawless rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear mix and instrument separation; reviewers note subtle cuts in the tape, the most noticeable being between St. Stephen and Not Fade Away, which slightly hurts flow.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Short, packed set with no wasted time; overall momentum is strong despite a brief edit that interrupts the transition from St. Stephen to Not Fade Away.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as a 'self‑generating source of electricity' with an impressive solo on China > Rider and powerful lead throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted for his big presence on Morning Dew, early return in the mix after Good Lovin', and solid bass foundation.
band_member_comments.Bob: Shares vocal duties with Pigpen and provides steady rhythm guitar support.
band_member_comments.Drums: Praised for a strong drum intro into Good Lovin' and consistent rhythmic drive across the set.
